arms.x1: logistic over [cross-encoder logit (X0 seed n, weights checked against X0's result), log1p(haversine km from source coordinates), LGA agreement (folded admin2 equal), coordinates-missing indicator], fitted per seed on the development labels

development.labels: data/review_packs/nigeria_facilities_2026-08-19/adjudication_pack_reviewed.csv (180: 86 same, 94 different, with the three corrections of 2026-11-21)
development.note: these labels were the test of the E0b transfer test and of X0; here they are development data only

distance_note: distance is computed from GRID3 v2 latitude/longitude and the HFR state file's lat/lon for both packs; it is not learned from the crosswalk, where 98.3% of linked pairs are 0 km apart because HFR copied GRID3 coordinates
known_risks: thresholds set on 180 development pairs (94 negatives) are coarse: a 1% false-positive rate there means none
question: Does the X0 cross-encoder, combined with distance and LGA agreement, decide part of a fresh review band within the error bound?

rule.decision: auto-match if P >= hi, auto-reject if P <= lo, else held; hi = smallest threshold with false-positive rate <= 1% on the development labels, lo = largest threshold with false-negative rate <= 1% there
rule.error_bound: errors among auto-decided <= 3% and Wilson 95% upper bound <= 10%
rule.latency: CPU p95 per pair at 4 threads <= 50 ms
rule.pass: every one of the 3 seeds meets fewer_held and error_bound
rule.population: the review-band pairs of data/review_packs/nigeria_facilities_x1_2026-11-21 (272, today's engine, sharing no GRID3 or HFR record with the 2026-08-19 pack) that the maintainer marked same_entity or different; read once, after this file
secondary: X0 replicated on the X1 labels exactly as preregistered then: crosswalk-calibrated cross-encoder, X0's recorded thresholds, same pass rule
the two-cosine logistic baseline replicated likewise, with X0's recorded weights and thresholds
per state counts (the pack is 252 Ondo, 15 Edo, 5 Kano)

test.labels: the maintainer's marks, exported from Studio after this file was written; not read before
